summary: Minimal, correct fix that removes the squashed migration's own django_migrations row on unapply, mirroring how MigrationExecutor.check_replacements() records that row on apply once all replaced migrations are applied. Resolves the reported inconsistency without regression risk since record_unapplied is a filtered delete (no-op when the row is absent).

issues.description: Slight asymmetry: the squash's own row is added in check_replacements() but removed here in unapply_migration(); centralizing or cross-referencing would aid clarity. Not blocking.
